description: Hand the edit to another NLE: "edl" (CMX3600 — Premiere/Resolve/Avid), "fcpxml" (Final Cut Pro/Resolve), "otio" (OpenTimelineIO), "csv" (shot list) or "chapters" (YouTube chapters from sections/markers). Writes a file in the project folder and returns its content. References the original media; nothing is re-encoded.
name: studio_export_timeline
